basic_details.job_title: IIT Bhilai JRF Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering at IIT Bhilai has advertised one JRF position in the SERB-CRG (now ANRF) funded project "A Systematic Design of Robust Memory Cell Using Ferroelectric FET (FeFET) for AI Hardware Accelerator". The pay is Rs. 37,000 plus 18% HRA per month for a tenure of 1 year or up to the availability of funds. A B.E./B.Tech. or M.E./M.Tech. in ECE/allied branches with GATE/NET qualification is needed. The application form with resume must reach the Principal Investigator at [email protected] by 20 November 2026, 11:59 PM.

age_limit.details: The age should not exceed 30 years on the last date of submission of the online application. Age relaxation may be given to outstanding candidates or candidates with relevant experience. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details.

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form attached with the advertisement.
Attach your resume to the completed form.
Mail or email the form and resume to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Nitanshu Chauhan, at [email protected].
Make sure the application reaches the PI by 20/11/2026, 11:59 PM.
The PI is not responsible for postal or courier delay, or any other reason for non-receipt at the specified time. Such an application will be disqualified or rejected.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be provided to the candidate for the interview. The appointment will be governed by the terms and conditions of the Institute/funding agency particularly applicable to the project, as and when required. The selected candidate will have to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer. The positions are available immediately.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Bhilai
content_sections.text: IIT Bhilai is an institute at Bhilai, Chhattisgarh - 491002. This post sits in a research project led by Principal Investigator Dr. Nitanshu Chauhan, Assistant Professor, Electronics and Communication Engineering. The notice directs readers to the PI's homepage for other details and the project team.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian nationals. The notice prints one post, JRF, with 1 position. Either of the two qualification routes below is accepted. Desirable skills and experience, as printed: Knowledge of basic semiconductor, solid-state devices, MOS Device Physics and Modelling, CMOS-based circuit design, and Memory Design EDA/TCAD tools, Cadence tools, TCAD device/process simulation, mixed-mode simulation Hardware Descriptive Language: Verilog or Verilog-A Minimum two (02) years relevant VLSI Industry/research experience The age should not exceed 30 years on the last date of submission of the online application. Age relaxation may be given to outstanding candidates or candidates with relevant experience. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details.

rows.essential_qualification: B.E./B.Tech. in ECE/allied branches with a minimum 60% mark (or a minimum CGPA of 6.5 on a 10-point scale) + GATE/UGC-NET JRF/CSIR NET JRF or equivalent examination qualification, OR M.E./M.Tech. in ECE/allied branches with the same marks or CGPA + the same examination qualification

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The JRF is paid Rs. 37,000/- (Rupees thirty-seven thousand only) plus 18% HRA per month for scholars who are selected through National Eligibility Tests (CSIR-UGC NET JRF or GATE). The notice also refers to selection through national-level examinations conducted by Central Government departments, their agencies and institutions. The duration is 1 year, or up to the availability of the funds, and may be extended for another year based on performance and fund availability. The fellowship may be terminated with a 30-day notice before completion of the tenure if performance till date is not deemed satisfactory.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Bhilai JRF
content_sections.text: The PI is not responsible for postal or courier delay, or any other reason for non-receipt at the specified time. Such an application will be disqualified or rejected.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be provided to the candidate for the interview. The appointment will be governed by the terms and conditions of the Institute/funding agency particularly applicable to the project, as and when required. The selected candidate will have to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer. The positions are available immediately.

faq.question: Q1. How many JRF posts are there at IIT Bhilai?
faq.answer: There is 1 (one) JRF position in the SERB-CRG (now ANRF) funded project on FeFET-based robust memory cell design.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Bhilai JRF post?
faq.answer: The application must reach the PI at [email protected] by 20/11/2026, 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Bhilai JRF post?
faq.answer: B.E./B.Tech. or M.E./M.Tech. in ECE/allied branches with a minimum 60% marks (or CGPA 6.5 on a 10-point scale), plus GATE/UGC-NET JRF/CSIR NET JRF or an equivalent examination qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT Bhilai JRF?
faq.answer: The age should not exceed 30 years on the last date of submission of the online application. Relaxation may be given to outstanding candidates or those with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIT Bhilai JRF?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 37,000/- plus 18% HRA per month for scholars selected through CSIR-UGC NET JRF or GATE.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 37,000 JRF pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice states Rs. 37,000/- plus 18% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the IIT Bhilai JRF post?
faq.answer: Fill in the attached application form and mail or email it with your resume to the PI at [email protected] so that it reaches by 20/11/2026, 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected for the IIT Bhilai JRF post?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, and the decision of the selection committee is final.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the IIT Bhilai JRF appointment?
faq.answer: The duration is 1 year, or up to the availability of the funds, and may be extended for another year based on performance and fund availability.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA will be provided to the candidate for the interview.
